title: C Programming Fundamentals
description: Learn the foundational systems language that powers operating systems, compilers, and embedded firmware. Master types, functions, arrays, pointers, structs, and dynamic memory.
prerequisites: None, though basic programming logic helps
outcomes: Compile and run clean C11 programs with strict compiler warnings
Work confidently with primitive types, format specifiers, and control flow
Manipulate fixed arrays and null-terminated C strings safely
Understand memory addresses, pointers, and pass-by-reference patterns
Design structs and manage heap memory cleanly with malloc and free
